faq.q: How many years of experience does Sugriv have?
faq.a: Sugriv has 4+ years of professional experience: Full Stack Development Intern at Newton School (2021-2022), React.js Developer at Cimet (2022-2023), React.js Developer at Tecmantras Solutions (2023-2024), and Full Stack Developer at Cilans System (June 2024 - present).

faq.q: What type of role is Sugriv looking for?
faq.a: Sugriv is open to freelance projects, collaborations, and new full-time opportunities as a Full Stack Developer.

Yes. He has worked with OpenAI API integration, conversational AI assistants, voice AI using the OpenAI Realtime API, AI-powered search (including Typesense-powered product search in production), recommendation systems, RAG concepts, prompt engineering, and LLM application integration. This portfolio's AI assistant is itself built on the OpenAI Realtime API.

faq.q: What AWS services has Sugriv used?
faq.a: EC2 (deployment with PM2), RDS and Aurora (PostgreSQL setup, subnet groups, security groups), S3 (file storage), VPC/Subnets/Security Groups, IAM roles and access control, plus working knowledge of Load Balancers, CloudFront and Route 53.

faq.q: How would Sugriv design an e-commerce application?
faq.a: Based on his experience: a Next.js frontend for SEO and performance, NestJS/Node.js services behind REST or GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL for transactional data (orders, payments) with Prisma or Sequelize, MongoDB for flexible product catalogs where appropriate, Redis + BullMQ for background jobs, Typesense for fast product search, Socket.IO for real-time updates, Razorpay/Stripe webhooks for payments, and AWS (EC2/RDS/S3) for deployment - a microservice approach he has used in production.
